name: AWS Elastic Beanstalk
overview: AWS Elastic Beanstalk deploys and manages web applications while provisioning supporting AWS resources; users retain access to underlying resources.
examSignals: Deploy web application with managed environment/platform and configurable underlying resources: Elastic Beanstalk
Simplest managed web app deploy from source/image: App Runner

compareWith.diff: Beanstalk offers environment/resource configurability; App Runner provides a more streamlined managed web service deployment.
